summary_en: Amifa declared a dividend of 40 yen per share for fiscal year ending September 2026, comprising 30 yen ordinary dividend and 10 yen special commemorative dividend, up from the prior guidance of 30 yen, marking the company's relocation to Shibuya headquarters.
title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend of Surplus Funds (Commemorative Dividend) for Fiscal Year Ending September 2026
translation_en_brief:
On November 13, 2026, Amifa's board of directors resolved to pay a dividend of 40 yen per share for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026, comprising an ordinary dividend of 30 yen and a special commemorative dividend of 10 yen. This represents an increase of 10 yen from the dividend guidance of 30 yen announced on May 15, 2026. The record date is September 30, 2026, with an effective date of November 30, 2026, and the total dividend amount is 128 million yen.

The company explained that the special commemorative dividend was decided to express gratitude to shareholders on the occasion of the company's relocation of its headquarters to Shibuya, Tokyo in May 2026, marking an important milestone in the company's business expansion and strengthening of its management foundation. The dividend was calculated by excluding one-time items such as compensation for transfer and headquarters relocation costs from the reported net income.

Amifa's dividend policy targets a payout ratio of 30 percent and dividend on equity (DOE) of 3 percent or above, with the objective of ensuring necessary internal reserves for future business development and operational stability while implementing stable and continuous dividend distributions.
